# Money-Finder

Money-Finder provides low-cost machine-readable APIs designed for autonomous AI agents. Paid endpoints use x402 v2 with USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). No user account, API key, or subscription is required for buyers.

## Free discovery

- Homepage: https://money-finder-nu.vercel.app/
- Catalog: https://money-finder-nu.vercel.app/api/catalog
- OpenAPI: https://money-finder-nu.vercel.app/openapi.json

## Paid service: AI Web Readiness Audit

GET https://money-finder-nu.vercel.app/api/agent-web-audit?url={PUBLIC_HTTPS_URL}

Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call.
Protocol: x402 v2.
Network: Base mainnet (eip155:8453).

Purpose: Evaluate a public HTTPS page for AI crawler access and machine-discovery readiness. The response includes a readiness score, page metadata, robots.txt and llms.txt discovery information, Open Graph and JSON-LD checks, and homepage access status for common AI crawlers.

Input query parameter:
- url: required public HTTPS URL. Example: https://example.com

Typical use cases:
- determine whether an AI agent or crawler is likely permitted to access a site
- check whether a site publishes llms.txt
- inspect canonical, Open Graph and structured-data readiness
- preflight a website before recommending, indexing, citing or optimizing it
- batch-evaluate public websites in autonomous workflows

A request without a valid x402 payment returns HTTP 402 Payment Required and a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header describing the payment terms. A compatible x402 client can pay programmatically and retry the request.
